terms.grammar: phrase: the locative domī with labōrāre
terms.comment: A plain description; no reference work has a term for remote work. Say only that one works, labōrāre, with the place.

phrases.latin: ego in tablīnum eō, ut labōrem
phrases.english: I’m going into the study to work
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

phrases.english: Daddy is working from home today.

sources: Lewis & Short: laboro · Lewis & Short: domus
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 11 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
